body.name: \(N^{\star}(n,K,d,\tau,s)\)
body.construction: \(N^{\star}(n,K,d,\tau,s)=\inf_{\mathcal A}\sup_{\mathfrak m\in\mathfrak M_{n,K,d,\tau}}\operatorname{depth}_{\mathfrak m}(\mathcal A)\), where the infimum ranges over adaptive recovery trees, with value \(\infty\) when no such finite tree recovers \(\mathsf T(\mathbf G)\) for every \(\mathfrak m\).
